20.en: "The greatest heroes are forged by war and tempered by suffering."

38.en: Conflict is vital to the survival of the Imperium.

54.en: Humanity’s greatest achievements are results of war and conflict.

76.en: Promote warmongering across the Imperium by instilling superstition, suspicion, and the need for violence within the citizenry. Seek out anyone with a base of power and work their phobias and prejudices until they march to war, believing it was their idea to begin with.

82.en: Isstvanians believe in the evolutionary power of war and incite conflict to strengthen Humanity across the Imperium. Others think them Radical, but they see evidence to confirm their beliefs throughout the Imperium’s history, where great generals proved the strength and ingenuity of men on the battlefield and in the void. And they see it in the current Imperium, where the wealthy have grown soft and the masses weak. They believe war drives invention and pushes Humanity to improve. At the same time, the destruction it wreaks clears the way for new and better societies across the Imperium, something sure to please the Emperor.

86.en: Isstvanians see the Macharian Crusade as the sector’s golden age but will not stand aside and let it slip into a decadent peace now. With the high military presence and turbulent politics here, Isstvanians can work subtly, nudging local governors into resisting Imperial rule. Such work, if exposed, would damage the relations between the Inquisition and local Imperial forces. Of course, such machinations are not easy to identify or prove.

90.en: While Isstvanians rarely declare their philosophy, many are sympathetic to their cause in the Inquisition and the Astra Militarum.

94.en: Many rely upon the Imperium’s war machine to give purpose to their lives or as a means to wield certain powers, just as the Imperium relies upon warfare to survive. However, due to the chaos it can wreak, the Isstvanian tendency to provoke violence wherever they go does not sit well with @UUID[.R7LueEsDUhrSYHNn]{Amalathians} or the Imperium’s bureaucrats.

110.en: Isstvanians are agitators wherever they go. They will attempt to stir characters up, leading them towards violent solutions or get them to march their forces to war. They will not shy away from stirring up both sides of a conflict to see who comes out on top.

118.en: To them, every agent, asset, or enemy is little more than a regicide piece in a greater game. They need their ‘pieces’ to always be in top form. They will not suffer from their agent’s pointless minutiae, especially personal issues.

126.en: Isstvanians are highly calculated individuals. Though they seek to promote warfare, they only act when they know their chosen side can win. Often, their choices and orders appear bizarre or off-target, but everything is in favour of building up to their next coup de grace.

140.en: An Ork Waaagh! fleet has been detected moving towards the remote shrine world of Iota Primaris. The @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Imperial Fleet} will be unable to deploy there on time, and the weary planetary leaders seek ways to evacuate the world. But the Isstvanian Patron sees an opportunity. Characters must travel to Iota Primaris, find what heresy weakens the leadership, oust them, and rally the populace to fight the xenos threat.

148.en: Heresy has taken hold over two hive cities on Opulus Major — Koria and Vinov each have deeply embedded Chaos cults manipulating the leadership. The Isstvanian Patron knows they can save one hive, but only by sacrificing the other. Characters must infiltrate each hive’s leadership and push them to war against the other. One of the two hives will come out on top, rooting out these cults and ultimately becoming stronger to withstand future heresies.
